title: Load Balancers
subtitle: A load balancer is only as good as its idea of which servers are alive
motto: Spread the traffic, and stop sending it to the dead
keyInsight: Spreading traffic is easy; the value of a balancer is how fast it stops sending traffic to a server that has died.

decisions.title: Count requests lost, not just utilization
decisions.description: The failure frames report failed requests during the incident, since a dead server behind round robin looks fine on a utilization chart.
decisions.alternatives: Reporting only utilization would show 60% on every alive server and hide the 90,000 failed requests.

decisions.title: Make detection time the trade-off
decisions.description: Health checks are shown as a check interval times a failure count, so learners see that faster detection loses fewer requests but risks removing a healthy server.
decisions.alternatives: Modeling perfect instant detection would make health checks look free.
